name: Loonie's Cool Game for Inflation Weirdos: (Also Juliet is in it.)
source:
Meet Juliet. She’s an overworked, underpaid fast food worker

Meet Loonie. She’s an extra-dimensional energy being who inhabits Juliet’s body.

Together they can become a giant inflated clown monster.

And tonight, they’re delivering your fast food order!

Navigate social pathways with this giant clown girl and her weird hand puppet friend to get your cheeseburger.

[From [url=https://ntportant.itch.io/loonies-cool-game]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
认识朱丽叶。她是一名工作过度、工资过低的快餐店工人

认识卢尼。她是居住在朱丽叶身体里的超维度能量存在。

他们在一起可以成为一个巨大的充气小丑怪物。

今晚，他们将交付你订购的快餐！

与这个巨大的小丑女孩和她奇怪的手偶朋友一起探索社交途径，以获得你的芝士汉堡。

[来自[url=https://ntportant.itch.io/loonies-cool-game]itch.io[/url]]
